<div class="nm" data-ver="1009voice">
  <div class="nm-head">
    <a href="/asonde/">← Play &amp; Learn games</a>
    <div class="nm-eye">TOMODACHI JAPAN · PLAY &amp; LEARN</div>
    <h1>Your Name in Japanese</h1>
    <span class="nm-jp">にほんごで じこしょうかい しよう！</span>
    <p>Type your name and pick what you like. You get your name in katakana and your first Japanese self-introduction, with romaji, English and sound.</p>
    <span class="nm-ok">🏫 Free for classroom use · No sign-up</span>
  </div>
  <div class="nm-studio">
    <div class="nm-box">
      <div class="nm-q"><label class="nm-lab" for="nmName"><i>1</i>Your name <small>なまえ</small></label>
        <input type="text" id="nmName" maxlength="24" placeholder="e.g. Emily, Lucas, Mia" autocomplete="off">
        <div id="nmFixBox" hidden><input type="text" id="nmKanaIn" maxlength="20" placeholder="Type katakana (e.g. エミリー)" style="margin-top:8px"><span class="nm-fixnote">Not quite right? Ask a Japanese friend or teacher and type it here.</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="nm-q"><span class="nm-lab"><i>2</i>Where? <small>どこから？</small></span>
        <div class="nm-seg"><button type="button" class="on" data-place="from">I'm from…</button><button type="button" data-place="live">I live in…</button></div>
        <select id="nmCountry" aria-label="Country"></select></div>
      <div class="nm-q"><span class="nm-lab"><i>3</i>How old are you? <small>なんさい？</small></span><div class="nm-chips nm-age" id="nmAgeChips"></div><select id="nmAge" hidden></select></div>
      <div class="nm-q"><span class="nm-lab"><i>4</i>Favorite food <small>すきな たべもの</small></span><div class="nm-chips" id="nmFoodChips"></div><select id="nmFood" hidden></select></div>
      <div class="nm-q"><span class="nm-lab"><i>5</i>Something you like <small>すきな もの</small></span><div class="nm-chips" id="nmLikeChips"></div><select id="nmLike" hidden></select></div>
      <div class="nm-q"><label class="nm-check"><input type="checkbox" id="nmStudy" checked> I'm learning Japanese 📚</label></div>
      <button type="button" class="nm-go" id="nmGo">✨ See my self-introduction</button>
    </div>
    <div class="nm-out">
      <div class="nm-tag"><div class="nm-tag-top">はじめまして！<small>HELLO, MY NAME IS</small></div><div class="nm-tag-name" id="nmKana">？</div><div class="nm-tag-ro" id="nmKanaRo"></div><div class="nm-tag-fix">Is this right? <button type="button" id="nmFix">✏️ Fix it</button></div></div>
      <div class="nm-card" id="nmCard"><h2>じこしょうかい · My Self-Introduction</h2><div id="nmLines"></div></div>
      <div class="nm-tog"><button type="button" class="on" id="nmTogRo">Romaji</button><button type="button" class="on" id="nmTogEn">English</button><button type="button" id="nmAll">🔊 Listen</button></div>
      <div class="nm-acts"><button type="button" class="nm-main" id="nmSave">📷 Save as picture</button><button type="button" id="nmSend">📤 Send</button><button type="button" id="nmPrint">🖨 Print</button></div>
      <div class="nm-msg" id="nmMsg"></div>
      <div class="nm-share" id="nmShare"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="nm-cta"><p><b>Want to talk with real kids in Japan?</b><br>Tomodachi Japan is an online Japanese school for kids around the world, taught by teachers from Japanese elementary schools.</p><a id="nmCta" href="/en/apply/?utm_source=namemaker&amp;utm_medium=cta&amp;utm_campaign=asonde-en">📩 Get school news (free)</a></div>
  <div class="nm-learn">
    <h2>How do you write your name in Japanese?</h2>
    <p>Names from other countries are written in <b>katakana</b> (カタカナ), one of the three Japanese writing systems. Japanese uses sounds like <i>ka, mi, ri</i>, so your name is changed to the closest Japanese sounds. For example, Emily becomes エミリー (Emirī). The line ー makes a sound longer.</p>
    <h2>What is “jikoshoukai”?</h2>
    <p><b>じこしょうかい (jikoshōkai)</b> means self-introduction. Japanese kids start with <b>はじめまして (hajimemashite)</b> — “nice to meet you” — and finish with <b>よろしく おねがいします (yoroshiku onegaishimasu)</b>, a friendly way to say “I hope we get along.”</p>
    <h2>For teachers</h2>
    <p>Use this page in your Japanese class: students make their introduction, practice with the 🔊 buttons, then print it or say it to the class. Free to use, no sign-up needed.</p>
  </div>
</div>
